content.about_description: The ET5 is NIO's compact saloon: a dual-motor, all-wheel-drive car with strong performance, a low centre of gravity and a battery pack designed to be exchanged as well as charged. Its cabin is software-led, with assistance systems that rely on cameras and radar staying correctly calibrated. Servicing an ET5 well means paying attention to the things a fast, heavy saloon actually wears — tyres, brakes, bushings — while properly testing the high-voltage system that makes it move. At EVS we assess battery state of health and thermal performance, diagnose both drive units, service brakes and suspension, and carry out software and calibration work along with warranty-related repair.
